title: Tailwise Plus Annual Purchase from a Free Tier — Program Rule and Customer Purchase Tool
content:
## Program rule

Under **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, when a customer on a free tier buys Tailwise Plus Annual, the first-term Plus Annual fee is charged to the card on file on the purchase date and the paid term starts that day.

> The first-term Plus Annual fee is fixed only after the membership carries the free tier that its qualifying spend has earned.

Restated in the same terms: while the membership does not yet carry the free tier that its qualifying spend has earned, the first-term Plus Annual fee is not fixed.

## Purchase tool: `buy_plus_tier_1a1727fb`

**Capability.** Buys a Tailwise Plus paid tier on the customer's own Pals Rewards membership and pays its first fee today with the card on file. One call moves the membership to the chosen paid tier starting today, opens a paid term of one billing cycle (one month for the monthly tier, one year for the annual tiers) beginning today with automatic renewal switched on and the next fee due the day after the term ends, books one fee charge for the term in the amount stated, and, when an enrollment bonus is stated, books one enrollment bonus entry dated today and adds it to the points balance.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The care agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the customer's Pals Rewards membership, as given by the care agent from the membership record | identifier |
| `plus_tier` | the paid tier being bought: Tailwise Plus Monthly (billed every month), Tailwise Plus Annual (billed once a year) or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual (premier tier billed once a year); Pals Rewards Member, Pals Rewards Insider and Pals Rewards VIP are free tiers and cannot be bought here | one of the six tier names |
| `first_charge_usd` | the fee charged today for the first term, exactly as the care agent quoted it | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `enrollment_bonus_points` | the enrollment bonus posted with this enrollment, as the care agent stated it; 0 when no enrollment bonus is due | whole non-negative integer of points |

**Return.** On success: status `purchased`, the `membership_id`, `variant_name` (the paid tier now held), `plus_term_start`, `plus_term_end` (last day of the term), `next_billing_date`, `member_event_id` (the fee charge's reference number), `amount_usd` charged, `enrollment_bonus_points` posted and `points_balance` afterwards.
